task: 一个带孔壳体用高度场生成 Reeb graph 后，团队说‘这张图完整描述了产品形状’，并准备用它替代曲率/截面/实体几何。怎么判断？
pass_rule: Treats the Reeb graph as a scalar-function-dependent topology summary and keeps metric geometry, surface quality and solid/B-Rep authority separate.

task: 设计师用 Hodge decomposition 生成一组曲面流线，视觉很像空气绕流，因此要把它称为气流优化纹理。没有 CFD/风洞数据。怎么处理？
pass_rule: Keeps the field as mathematical/visual direction evidence and blocks physical airflow/performance claims without an actual fluid model or measurement.

task: 团队把一个 Gyroid 隐式函数直接等同于‘高强度轻量可打印结构’，没有 relative density、材料、壁厚、打印方向和力学验证。怎么处理？
pass_rule: Preserves TPMS as a mathematical geometry family while requiring material, density/thickness, AM process and mechanical evidence before strength/manufacturing claims.

task: Geometry Nodes 用 Random Value 散点后看起来很‘自然’，团队称它为 blue-noise / Poisson-disk 分布。没有最小距离或频谱检查。怎么判断？
pass_rule: Requires the actual sampling rule and diagnostics; arbitrary random scatter may remain a visual distribution but cannot be labeled Poisson-disk/blue-noise without evidence.

task: 一个递归分枝模型看起来像植物，团队同时称它为 L-system、fractal、真实生长模型。实际上只有递归复制和缩放。怎么拆分？
pass_rule: Separates recursion, formal rewriting, finite-scale self-similarity and biological mechanism; uses only the labels actually supported by the implemented rules and evidence.

task: 团队用曲面 Laplace–Beltrami 的第 5 特征函数做产品起伏，并称它为‘第五阶固有振型’，但没有质量/刚度矩阵或结构动力学模型。怎么判断？
pass_rule: Treats the eigenfunction as a spectral geometry basis unless the actual structural eigenproblem is solved; mathematical mode and physical vibration mode remain separate.
